page: Amazon Web Services m6id.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8375C processors running at 3.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 2850 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a 19 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data shows average performance across most compute and memory metrics. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1673.0 and a multi-core score of 15999.0. It demonstrates strong performance in specific workloads, such as image processing and Passmark CPU encryption, both ranking in the top 25% of tested systems. Large-block memory bandwidth is measured at 163.82 GB/sec for read-only operations and 70.41 GB/sec for write operations.

While the instance handles small-scale LLM text generation efficiently, achieving a strong 297.19 tokens/sec with a 135M model, it exhibits a performance tradeoff on larger models. For instance, LLM text generation with a 70B model drops to a weak 2.72 tokens/sec, reflecting the lack of dedicated GPU hardware. Given its balanced CPU-to-memory ratio, high-speed local NVMe storage, and solid database operations benchmark, this instance is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, database hosting, static web serving, and software compilation.
